# Sed injection config for Google tool
# Format: PATTERN|ACTION|INJECTION
# ACTION: 'a' = append after, 'i' = insert before

# 1. Add import statement
import { WebSearchTool } from "./websearch"|a|import { GoogleTool } from "./google"

# 2. Add tool initialization
websearch = yield|a|    const google = yield* GoogleTool

# 3. Add to Effect.all
search: Tool.init(websearch),|a|          google: Tool.init(google),

# 4. Add to builtin array
tool.search,|a|            tool.google,
